label: Certiorari denied
caption: BELL, MICHAEL V. DIXON, SEC., FL DOC, ET AL.
text: The application for stay of execution of sentence of death presented to Justice Thomas and by him referred to the Court is denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied. Justice Sotomayor and Justice Kagan would grant the application for stay and the petition for a writ of certiorari.
